description: This module can register, update and delete required actions.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_keycloak_url
parameters.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the realm in which are the authentication required actions.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: required_actions
parameters.description: Authentication required action.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Unique name of the required action.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Configuration for the required action.

parameters.name: defaultAction
parameters.description: Indicates whether new users have the required action assigned to them. Choices: false true

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Indicates, if the required action is enabled or not. Choices: false true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Displayed name of the required action. Required for registration.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Priority of the required action.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: Provider ID of the required action. Required for registration.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Control if the realm authentication required actions are going to be registered/updated (present) or deleted (absent). Choices: "absent" "present"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Register a new required action.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication_required_actions:
    auth_client_id: "admin-cli"
    auth_keycloak_url: "http://localhost:8080"
    auth_password: "password"
    auth_realm: "master"
    auth_username: "admin"
    realm: "master"
    required_actions:
      - alias: "TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS"
        name: "Terms and conditions"
        providerId: "TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS"
        enabled: true
    state: "present"

- name: Update the newly registered required action.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication_required_actions:
    auth_client_id: "admin-cli"
    auth_keycloak_url: "http://localhost:8080"
    auth_password: "password"
    auth_realm: "master"
    auth_username: "admin"
    realm: "master"
    required_actions:
      - alias: "TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS"
        enabled: false
    state: "present"

- name: Delete the updated registered required action.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication_required_actions:
    auth_client_id: "admin-cli"
    auth_keycloak_url: "http://localhost:8080"
    auth_password: "password"
    auth_realm: "master"
    auth_username: "admin"
    realm: "master"
    required_actions:
      - alias: "TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS"
    state: "absent"

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the authentication required actions after module execution. Returned: on success

return_values.name: alias
return_values.description: Unique name of the required action. Returned: success Sample: "test-provider-id"

return_values.name: config
return_values.description: Configuration for the required action. Returned: success Sample: {}

return_values.name: defaultAction
return_values.description: Indicates whether new users have the required action assigned to them. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: Indicates, if the required action is enabled or not. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Displayed name of the required action. Required for registration. Returned: success Sample: "Test provider ID"

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: Priority of the required action. Returned: success Sample: 90

return_values.name: providerId
return_values.description: Provider ID of the required action. Required for registration. Returned: success Sample: "test-provider-id"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message as to what action was taken. Returned: always
